analytic_scope: Exact Schur excess and conditional weighted remainder; complete local Wilson/source jets and conditional scale budgets
not_established: Uniform interacting Wilson SP8/coarse matching, complete spatial trajectory and continuum measure

checks.name: Spatial Schur excess is exact with noncommuting fast blocks
checks.detail: Two retained and two fast directions, nonzero reference cross coupling, two signed couplings and two energies; exact full rational inverses agree

checks.name: Spatial second jet includes every baseline and fast-variation cross term
checks.detail: Direct three-factor inverse-series convolution matches the full graph coefficient; a2-b1(F0-z)^-1 b1* fails, as does the undressed cubic force

checks.name: Spatial energy derivative retains the full induced graph metric
checks.detail: The derivative of the exact energy pencil is -(1+B(F-z)^-2 B*); discarding memory would falsely give a unit metric
checks.section: WILSON_SPATIAL; G19 SP6; WILSON_SPATIAL_SCHUR_INPUT sections 1 and 5

checks.name: Spatial source straightening has both commutators and the nested term
checks.detail: Independent coefficient multiplication of U*HU with a noncommuting, second-order unitary jet verifies the source terms and their signs

checks.name: Actual SU2 harmonic commutator has nonzero quartic Wilson energy
checks.detail: The actual ordered four-link SU2 word has zero linear curl yet 2 g^-2 v = (g^2/2)x^2 y^2 + higher orders; harmonic coordinates remain interacting

checks.name: Actual nonzero-curl Wilson quartic retains all three logarithmic terms
checks.detail: An actual three-loop SU2 word gives quartic terms (5/8, -3/2, -27/32); their sum -55/32 agrees with direct exponential-word multiplication

checks.name: Actual SU2 radial Haar flattening retains its electric second-order scalar
checks.detail: On SU2 class functions the exact flattened radial electric operator is -1/2(d_r^2+2/r d_r)-1/8, yielding -g^2/8 after dilation; metric and Haar are combined

checks.name: Actual averaged-path polar source has the complete second correction
checks.detail: Two noncommuting actual SU2 path words with weights 1/3 and 2/3: direct polar/log series reproduce the nonzero second source correction
checks.section: WILSON_SPATIAL; G19 SP17a; WILSON_SPATIAL_FLAT_INPUT section 4, actual redundant observation geometry

checks.name: Spatial normalized moving-source density has the complete second jet
checks.detail: Five exact Gaussian test moments agree with normalized pushforward; d1=2*x**3, d2=2*x**6 - 3*x**4 - 2*x**2 - 1/2. Omitting the ground/source cross term changes the second moment

checks.name: Spatial third-order remainder constant bounds a nonzero exact defect
checks.detail: Exact positive and negative coupling controls satisfy C3=16/3; a sign-changed fast-form variation leaves a nonzero bounded cubic defect

checks.name: Spatial gap iteration carries every accumulated comparison loss
checks.detail: Four distinct loss factors and doubling physical fast energies reproduce the exact weighted reciprocal-gap formula; omitting accumulated losses fails

checks.name: Spatial onto frames alone cannot preserve a specified observable
checks.detail: A frame of lower bound one can annihilate a chosen source; the separate telescoping amplitude budget leaves 9/32 and spectral weight at least 81/1024

retry_reason: The first collection failed on indentation in the new G19 ledger route. The repaired YAML was parsed directly, then the focused checks were rerun. The original error report is preserved; no full-regression pass is claimed.
